h: Chadwick Boseman's father, Leroy, dies six years after the Black Panther star
p: Leroy Boseman, father of the late Black Panther actor Chadwick Boseman, has reportedly died after a brief illness. His family described him as a beloved husband and father.
body: Leroy Boseman, the father of the late Hollywood actor Chadwick Boseman, has died after a brief illness, according to reports.

The family announced his death in a statement, describing him as a beloved husband and father whose impact went far beyond his connection to a famous son. They noted that many people would remember him mainly as the father of Derrick, Kevin and Chadwick Boseman, but stressed that he meant much more to those who knew and loved him.
Chadwick Boseman, best known for playing T'Challa in Marvel's Black Panther, died six years ago.
more: Leroy Boseman died after a brief illness.
The family paid tribute to him as a husband and father.
